kind: Go dependent-face reference fixture; not Rust import acceptance
command: Run generate.go from the Go application checkout with the source fixture and an output path.
observations: A face-offset work plane stores side-1 face key in model.workFeatures with a 0.5 cm offset.

Go reopens the 10 mm cube, resolves the unique face and a healthy plane at x=1.5 cm, changes size to 20 mm, saves and reopens, and resolves the unique face and plane at x=2.5 cm. The face areas are 1 cm² and 2 cm².
Rust currently refuses workFeatures before adopting the candidate; its regression test confirms the decoded package and an encode/decode round trip remain unchanged.
limitations: This is a Go-generated reference fixture, not evidence that Rust imports the dependent plane or resolves the face key.
The Go extrusion distance remains the saved fixed 10 mm.
Go save generates new revision identifiers, so byte identity is not expected across fixture generations.
